arabic text: HAR ZAKHM PAY SHUKRANA(2), ZAINAB KE LABON PAR HAI
english translation text: Upon every wound is gratitude —this remains upon Zainab's lips.

arabic text: EK GIRYA-E-KHOONI KI, JATI HI NAHI LAALI\nSAJJAD KI AANKHON KO DEKHA HI NAHI KHALI\nYA KHOON HAI AANKHON MEIN(2), YA SHAM KA MANZAR HAI
english translation text: The redness of blood-filled tears never leaves;\nSajjad's eyes were never seen empty.\nIs this blood within his eyes, or the scene of Shaam?

arabic text: LATKA DAR-E-KUFA PAR, DEKHA HAI KOI LASHA\nKYUN CHOAB SAY MEHMIL KI ZAINAB NAY HAI SAR MAARA\nAY WAQT LAHU SAY KYUN(2), ZAINAB KI JABEEN TAR HAI
english translation text: Did anyone see a body hanging at Kufa's gate?\nWhy did Zainab strike her forehead upon the litter's pole?\nO time, why is Zainab's forehead drenched in blood?

arabic text: YE SHOR-E-BUKA KYA HAI, MATAM KI SADA KYA HAI\nTAUHEED BACHAYE JO WO KARBOBALA KYA HAI\nYA HAI SAR-E-SARWAR YA(2), ZAINAB TERI CHADAR HAI
english translation text: What is this sound of weeping? What is this cry of matam?\nWhat is that Karbala which preserved tawheed?\nIs it Sarwar's severed head, or Zainab's chadar?

arabic text: LAY SHAM-E-GHARIBAN SE, PURHAUL BAYABAN TAK\nBAZAR SE KUFA TAK DARBAR SE ZINDAN TAK\nBEREHM TAMACHAY HAIN(2), AUR SHAHA KI DUKHTAR HAI
english translation text: From the night of the bereaved to the terrifying wilderness,\nfrom the marketplace of Kufa, from the court to the prison,\nthere are merciless slaps, and there is the King's daughter.

arabic text: TAKRATI HAI SAR APNA, JAYE THO KAHAN JAYE\nMASOOM SAKINA KO GHASH AAYE KE MAUTH AAYE\nISKE LIYE ZINDAN MEIN(2), BUS KHAK KA BISTAR HAI
english translation text: She strikes her head—where can she go?\nWill innocent Sakina faint, or will death come?\nWithin the prison, only dust is her bedding.

arabic text: WOH QALB THAY KAISAY JO, JAAN LE GAYE SARWAR KI\nPATHAR THO WOH HAI JISNEY, PATHAR KI HAYA RAKHI\nA'E SANG-E-HALAB TUJKO(2), KAISE KAHOON PATHAR HAI
english translation text: What kind of hearts were those that took Sarwar's life?\nA stone at least preserved the modesty of a stone.\nO stone of Halab, how can I call you stone?

arabic text: JO BADKE HAR EK DURRA, KHUD PUSHT PAY KHAATI HAI\nKHUD KHOON MEIN NAHATI HAI, ZAINAB KO BACHATI HAI\nHAAN YEH HAI WOHI FIZZA(2), QAMBAR KI JO HUMSAR HAI
english translation text: She steps forward to receive every lash upon her own back;\nshe bathes in blood to protect Zainab.\nYes, this is that same Fizza, the equal of Qambar.

arabic text: KYUIN HAA'E HUSSAINA KA, EK SHOR SA UTHA HAI\nSAR GHAZI KA NAIZE SE KYUIN KHAAK PE GIRTA HAI\nGHAAZI KI BEHAN SHAYAD(2), BALWAY MEIN KHULE SAR HAI
english translation text: Why has a cry of 'Alas, Hussain' suddenly risen?\nWhy does Ghazi's head fall from the spear towards the dust?\nPerhaps Ghazi's sister stands bareheaded in the crowd.
